1. ItemLocation Filter
Filter to IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT.ITEM_LOCATION_TYPE_CD= IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT where  SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM in ('ItemGroup'), BUSINESS_RULE_NM ='ItemGroup_Config' and   COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT IN ('AssyGrpNm','FabGrpNm') and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT='ItemLocationType_Filter'

Production Engineering Filter: Include records with OWNER_CD=IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT where  SUBJECT_AREA_NM='Item' , ENTITY_NM in ('Item'), BUSINESS_RULE_NM ='ProductionEngineeringFilter' 

NSB Filter
Filter to IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT.NSB_FLAG= IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT where  SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM in ('ItemGroup'), BUSINESS_RULE_NM ='ItemGroup_Config' and   COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT IN ('AssyGrpNm') and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT='NSBFlag_Filter'
2.AssemblyItemGroup
a. Filter to item Classes: Filter  IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT.ITEM_CLASS_NM =IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM in ('ItemGroup'), BUSINESS_RULE_NM ='ItemGroup_Config' and   COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT='AssyGrpNm' and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT='ITEM_CLASS_NM_Filter' .  

b. ITEM ORDER POINT: Filter to only rows that have non null or non empty   ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_VALUE_TXT  in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_CORE_PIT where CHARACTERISTIC_NM=   V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT  where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM='ItemGroup', BUSINESS_RULE_NM = 'ItemGroup_Config' and COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT='AssyGrpNm' and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT='CHARACTERISTIC_NM_Filter'

c. Fetch the Item_Characteristic : Join the above results with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_CORE_PIT based on ITEM_ID   and get the ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_VALUE_TXT  where CHARACTERISTIC_NM=   V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT  where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM='ItemGroup', BUSINESS_RULE_NM = 'ItemGroup_Config'  and COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TEXT='AssyGrpNm'  and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TEXT='CHARACTERISTIC_NM'

e. ITEM_GROUP= Aggregate The Item_Characteristics into 1 line by Concatenating the ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_VALUE_TXT seperated by COLUMN_VALUE_FIVE_TXT. If a certain CHARACTERISTIC_NM is unavailable, replace with V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_SIX_TXT in the order of COLUMN_VALUE_FOUR_TXT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM='ItemGroup', BUSINESS_RULE_NM = 'ItemGroup_Config'  and COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TEXT='AssyGrpNm'  and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TEXT='CHARACTERISTIC_NM' . [AssyGrpNm]
Note: Use LISTGG() at an ITEM_ID level
2.FabItemGroup

Filter to item Classes: Filter  IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT.ITEM_CLASS_NM =IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT.COLUMN_VALUE_THREE_TXT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='ItemGroup' , ENTITY_NM in ('ItemGroup'), BUSINESS_RULE_NM ='ItemGroup_Config' and   COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT='FabGrpNm' and COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT='ITEM_CLASS_NM_Filter' 

ITEM_GROUP= IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_HYBRID_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT.ITEM_ID
Union results of AssemblyItemGroup and FabItemGroup
Keep Distinct rows only
Get Distinct ITEM_ID, ITEM_GROUP and LOCATION_ID combination 

SKU_GROUP=ITEM_GROUP +'_'+LOCATION_ID
DQ: 1 Item cannot belong to more than 1 item_grp
